name: Hourglass
summary: A soft fork proposal that rate-limits spends from quantum-vulnerable P2PK outputs. Limits P2PK spends to one per block and caps net release to 1 BTC per block, mitigating quantum-driven supply shocks if vulnerable coins are suddenly moved.
summaryZh: 一种软分叉提议，限制量子脆弱的 P2PK 输出的花费速率。将 P2PK 花费限制为每区块一次，净释放上限为每区块 1 BTC，以减轻脆弱币被突然转移时的量子驱动供应冲击。
